Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: complete.

ProtocolLongSuite directly serializes and parses shared wire values at 2^53−1, 2^53, 2^53+1, and Long.MaxValue, including progress, totals, preview counts, diagnostic loci, and envelopes. It also refuses unsafe numeric JSON, malformed strings, fractions, and overflow, preserving lossless text semantics across the shared protocol. Close the ticket; any remaining question is only whether closure needs the standard local cross-platform test receipt attached.
